motions.motion_name_zh: 左前爪轻擦左耳与脸部后恢复坐姿
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 16 frames at 4 fps: seated tabby lifts its own left forepaw (viewer right), touches the left ear/head side, sweeps down across its face, lowers the paw, and resumes sitting. Original video is 4 seconds, 24 fps, 720x1280, with an audio track.
